title: The result of FORMAT is text: it concatenates and compares as a string
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "joined", FORMAT ( 42, "0" ) & "!", "is text", ISTEXT ( FORMAT ( 42, "0" ) ) )

source.quote: Using FORMAT changes a measure result to a text data type.

derivation: FORMAT ( 42, "0" ) is the text "42"; with "!" appended it is "42!", and ISTEXT of a text value is TRUE.
